description: Phase 3A. Drives the engine through the spec-locked experimental-families gate transitions: default-OFF at Init, user toggles ON mid-soak, mode change does not clear the flag, network change does not clear the flag. The same 1.5C-class subscription-url block is layered on so the soak invariant ledger continues to assert the legacy distribution-failure gates. The Iranian-region caveat banner has no soak-side surface (it is a UI affordance gated by the trust-UI subsystem; tested in client-android / client-desktop integration tests).
